description: A precision voltage source for tuning, giving whole octaves and semitones on one jack and a 440Hz tone on another

params.text: Sets the whole volts of the output, marked 0 to 10
Sets the twelfths of a volt added to the octave setting, marked 0 to 11
Picks whether the octave and semitone settings come out positive or negative
Switches the 440Hz reference tone on and off

inputs.text: Added to the voltage the two knobs make

outputs.text: The octave and semitone voltage, with the add input summed into it
A 440Hz sine tone for tuning against
